g.text: Cellulose-annotated taxa reported decreased in stool overlap across PD, HIV and CRC
Mean pairwise Jaccard distance d_J = 0.479; 17 of 47 taxa appear in all three. Randomly chosen stool studies overlap about as much when their co-reported taxa are kept

Taxa: KG-Microbe matrix taxa annotated METPO:2000103|GO:0030245 (cellulose catabolic process; any rank, annotations rolled up from descendants) in at least one decreased stool signature of the condition.

Overlap counts reported taxonomic labels, not consistent loss: a taxon counts once it is reported decreased in any study. Monte Carlo p from 100,000 draws. PD, Parkinson's disease; HIV, HIV infection; CRC,
colorectal cancer. BugSigDB 2026-04-24_00:41_UTC; human profiles; condition and body site from each experiment's own record.
